---
title: "NEWS"
description: "Recent changes and new features in INTEGRATOR"
---

Binary releases are published on the
[GitHub Releases page](https://github.com/SLINGhub/MRMhub/releases).

## Latest changes

- **`param.txt` from older versions keeps working**: missing settings take their
  documented defaults and unknown ones are ignored; both are listed when a step
  starts. Whole numbers are accepted where a decimal is expected, and a wrong
  value stops the run with a message naming the setting instead of a crash.
- **New `long.csv` columns `sn_ratio` and `noise_method`**: signal-to-noise ratio
  of each peak, with the noise estimated around the peak (robust by default;
  RMS or pharmacopoeia peak-to-peak via `sn_noise` in `param.txt`).
- **`height` and `FWHM` measured above the integration baseline**: `height` is
  now the apex intensity minus the integration baseline (previously the raw
  apex intensity), and `FWHM` is measured at half of that height. `FWHM` is left
  empty when the peak is cut by the integration window, instead of reporting the
  window width. Compared with MassHunter on Dataset 4, 93 % of `FWHM` values agree
  within 10 % (previously 74 %). Workflows that quantify on `height` give different
  values with this version.
- **Transitions missing from some mzML files are retained**: such a transition
  is integrated in the files that contain it, provided it is present in all
  reference samples and in at least one learning sample; the other files receive
  empty values. Previously, the transition was removed from the whole dataset.
- **macOS build for Intel processors** (`x86_64-apple-darwin`), in addition to
  Apple silicon.
- **mzML files converted without "Write index" are read**: previously, their
  chromatograms were not read and step 1 terminated with an error.
- **mzML format check in step 1**: files without chromatograms or with an
  unsupported compression (e.g. MS-Numpress) stop step 1 with an error before
  any data are read, and are listed in `mzml_format_errors.txt`; the results of
  the previous run are left in place.
- **New `long.csv` column `trace_cut_pct`**: flags peaks cut off by the start
  or end of the acquired MRM trace and gives the signal remaining there as a
  percentage of the apex height above baseline.
- **Complete Rust source code**, including the **MRMhub-viz** viewer app, with
  build instructions.
- **Per-feature baseline determination**: the baseline mode (`default`
  5th-percentile, `v_drop`, or valley-to-valley `v2v`) can be set globally or
  overridden individually for each feature.
- **Input files referenced by column name, not position**: `run_order.csv` and
  `feature_list.csv` are matched on their header names, so columns may appear in
  any order, improving robustness.
- **Optional retention-time crop window**: `crop_window` restricts
  retention-time alignment and peak integration to a window around the expected
  retention time, useful for static-MRM acquisitions that record the full
  retention-time range.
- **Explicit transition-to-chromatogram mapping**: the optional
  `chromatogram_index` column selects which chromatogram ID to use when an mzML
  file contains multiple identical transitions.
- **Version number embedded in the code and executable**, carrying version and
  publisher metadata so binaries are properly identified, reducing
  antivirus/SmartScreen warnings.
